goal: Test whether a pretrained CPU audio transcription frontend materially improves local onset-aware pitch recognition on the exact historical calibration audio without human correction, Gold-guided construction, Modal, L4, CUDA, or GPU.

basicPitch.runtime: package default CPU runtime on Linux/Python 3.10

predefinedBranches.transcriber: Basic Pitch 0.4.0 defaults plus fixed guitar MIDI range 40-88

predefinedBranches.input: htdemucs_6s guitar stem generated on CPU from the same normalized mix
predefinedBranches.transcriber: Basic Pitch 0.4.0 defaults plus fixed guitar MIDI range 40-88

evaluation.primaryMetric: same-pitch one-to-one onset F1 within plus/minus 0.5 frozen grid step using continuous onset seconds
evaluation.secondaryMetric: same-pitch one-to-one onset F1 within plus/minus 2.0 frozen grid steps using continuous onset seconds
evaluation.selectionPolicy: Report both predefined branches. The branch with higher primary local pitch-timing F1 is the preferred frontend for the next reference-free stage; ties use secondary gross-pitch F1. No threshold tuning is permitted from this result.

interpretationBands.PROMISING_RESET: best primary F1 >= 0.10 and greater than accepted baseline
interpretationBands.WEAK_GAIN: best primary F1 greater than accepted baseline but below 0.10

forbidden: Gold/reference access before both branch outputs are persisted
